question: The price of bread is Rs.25 more than the price of the jam and the price of bread & jam together costs Rs.75.50. Find the price of the bread.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the total sum and difference of two values are given, the larger value is half of their sum.

Price of Bread = (Total Cost + Difference) ÷ 2

Price of Bread = (75.50 + 25) ÷ 2

Price of Bread = 100.50 ÷ 2 = 50.25

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 50.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost of Bread and Jam = Rs. 75.50

Difference in cost (Bread is more expensive than Jam) = Rs. 25

Let the price of the Jam be x.

Then, the price of the Bread = x + 25

 
 Jam (x)

 
 Bread (x + 25)

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Cost = 75.50

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Cost = Price of Jam + Price of Bread

⇒ x + (x + 25) = 75.50

⇒ 2x + 25 = 75.50

⇒ 2x = 75.50 − 25

⇒ 2x = 50.50

⇒ x = 50.50 ÷ 2

⇒ x = 25.25

⇒ Price of Bread = x + 25 = 25.25 + 25 = 50.25

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 50.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum and Difference Formula

If the sum of two numbers is S and their difference is D, the larger number is (S + D) ÷ 2 and the smaller number is (S − D) ÷ 2.

Linear Equations in One Variable

A linear equation is an algebraic equation where the highest exponent of the variable is exactly 1. It represents a straight line when plotted on a graph and is easily solved by isolating the unknown quantity on one side.
